name: set_listener_name
description: Save the person's name, once they have given or corrected it, so whoever they talk with next knows it. Reply with an empty message.

name.description: Their name as they said it, capitalised as a name.

name: handoff_to_guide
description: Hand the person over, right after the interviewer has said it is handing them over. Reply with an empty message.

name: end_debrief
description: End the conversation, right after the interviewer has said its farewell (it thanks them and ends "That's everything from me."). Reply with an empty message.
